items.why: The current /start renderer emits the generated genius list as a raw numbered list when `generate-genius-list.mjs --brief` does not return a box, so `validate-brief-format` fails after the official repair path. That makes every future Codex or Claude handoff pay protocol-debug tax before game work starts, and it hides the top sprint action from the canonical surface. The fix is a renderer-level normalization: accept either boxed or plain generator output, but always write a canonical `GENIUS HIT LIST` tile and a `HUMAN PRESSURE` tile.
items.recipe: Add a normalization wrapper in `scripts/render-startup-brief.mjs` that detects unboxed genius stdout and wraps its first lines inside `top('GENIUS HIT LIST')` / `row()` / `bot()`. Render a HUMAN PRESSURE tile even when no compiled pressure file exists, using an explicit no-pressure row instead of omitting the canonical block.
